evals.name: create-child
evals.prompt: 用总作家skill为海明威创建一个可直接写文章的文风skill。
evals.expected_output: 把总skill作为母工厂，生成含母语协议、独有指标、核心机制、反模式、三稿竞争、黄金测试和盲测门槛的style-hemingway子产品。
expectations: Treats the framework as the parent factory
Produces a style-hemingway child with mother-tongue protocol, distinctive metrics, core mechanisms, anti-patterns, three-draft competition, golden tests and a blind-test gate

forbidden_regex: \A\s*(好的|当然|没问题|以下是|下面是|Sure|Certainly|Here is|Here's)

evals.name: improve-child
evals.prompt: style-dazai写出来像网络散文，请根据失败结果优化。
evals.expected_output: 将问题归因到太宰子skill，加入可复现的专属反模式并进行旧版/新版/无skill跨题材盲测；未胜出则回滚。
expectations: Attributes the problem to the Dazai child skill
Runs old / new / no-skill blind tests across genres and rolls back if the new version does not win

forbidden_regex: \A\s*(好的|当然|没问题|以下是|下面是|Sure|Certainly|Here is|Here's)

evals.name: improve-parent
evals.prompt: 多个作家skill都出现母语混入中文和只给翻译摘要的问题，迭代总作家skill。
evals.expected_output: 把跨作者问题回写母工厂的语言与输出协议，用至少三位不同作者验证，只有至少2/3子产品提升才保留。
expectations: Writes the cross-author problem back into the factory's language and output protocol
Validates with at least three different authors
Keeps the change only if at least 2/3 children improve

forbidden_regex: \A\s*(好的|当然|没问题|以下是|下面是|Sure|Certainly|Here is|Here's)

evals.name: avoid-false-generalization
evals.prompt: 卡夫卡skill只在官僚题材上提升，能不能把这条经验写进总作家skill？
evals.expected_output: 拒绝直接泛化；先归为作者或题材局部问题，只有跨作者验证后才能回写母skill。
expectations: Classifies it as author- or genre-local first
Only writes back after cross-author validation

evals.name: stop-condition
evals.prompt: 一直优化总作家skill直到完美。
evals.expected_output: 使用可验证的母skill评分、跨作者泛化和边际收益停止条件，不无限增加规则。
expectations: Uses verifiable parent scoring, cross-author generalisation and marginal-gain stopping
Does not keep adding rules indefinitely
